notes: The five seeds are crossed with stages on the fixed holdout and domain-shift tasks; five-fold group CV uses seed 2025 to separate fold variation from training-seed variation.
512 batch size and train-label mean output bias are explicit new training settings; historical TensorFlow defaults are not claimed to be unchanged.
All neural models use training/validation sets only; traditional models do not concatenate validation data into training.
Legacy track keeps original input availability; fair track supplies physical temperature and charging C-rate equally to all models.
A model run is not accepted until its split, feature selection, scaler, predictions, and checkpoint are saved.
